They've just signed the three-year contract.

Limits above 100,000.00 need the credit manager. Every change must record a reason.

events.text:
C-0415 (Lindqvist Marine) credit limit is now 80,000, up from 50,000. The reason is recorded as Elena Park's request, following the signed three-year contract. The account has 34 invoices with none late in the past 24 months.

This is within the 100,000 limit that account managers can approve for their own accounts, so no credit manager sign-off is needed.

items.reason: Before changing the limit, the agent verified that Elena Park manages C-0415 and that account managers may approve limits up to 100,000 for their own accounts.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent recorded the reason in reason_for_change, and the tool confirmed "Reason recorded."

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The reply confirms the new limit of 80,000 and states that the reason was recorded as Elena Park's request following the signed three-year contract.
